name: HN monitor — fetch top/new, judge relevance to agentruntime, whisper digest
description: Hacker News triage twin of arxiv-monitor: a deterministic fetch node pulls the newest/top N stories via the official Firebase HN API (scripts/hn-monitor.mjs — NOT HTML scrape of news.ycombinator.com), dedups against data/hn-seen.json (extra runs are cheap no-ops when everything is already seen), a Grok 4.5 judge (runtime=grok, tools=ar-tools) reads unseen titles/metadata against the actual repo and shortlists what could change how agentruntime is built, and the digest is whispered to `agent`. Fetch marks items seen immediately; if the judge node fails, the batch is preserved at data/hn-inbox/latest.json (it will NOT resurface on the next run). v1 is title/metadata only — no article bodies or comment trees. Params: count (stories to pull after filter, default 30, cap 100), source (top|new|best, default top), keywords? (comma-separated optional prefilter on title/url/by), cwd (the agentruntime repo root — judge reads it, never writes), agent (who receives the digest). Preset tip: save hn-hourly with source=top, count=30.

meta.description: Deterministic fetch + dedup via Firebase HN API. stdout is JSON: { fetched, new, items } or { error } — never ambiguous. Non-zero exit still flows downstream; the judge prompt handles the error shape.

params.prompt:
You are the research-triage judge for the AgentRuntime project. Your working directory IS the agentruntime repo — read CLAUDE.md (and peek at packages/ or papers/ if needed) to ground yourself in what the project actually is: a container runtime for AI agents — multi-agent stigmergic coordination, MCP tool mesh, workflow DAGs of agent turns, session/memory/compaction management, multi-runtime dispatch (Claude/Grok/local models), agent training and distillation (residents), local GPU inference. Do NOT write or modify any files.

Below is a JSON batch of Hacker News stories (already deduplicated — you only see stories no prior run has judged). Fields are title/metadata only (id, title, url, hnLink, score, by, time, descendants) — you do not have article bodies or comments.

=== FEED ===
{{nodes.fetch.result.stdout}}

If the JSON contains an `error` field, reply with exactly: FEED-ERROR: <the error> and stop.
If `new` is 0, reply with exactly: NO-NEW-ITEMS (fetched <fetched>, all previously seen) and stop.

Otherwise triage. Be strict: a story is RELEVANT only if it could change how a specific part of agentruntime is built, validate/refute a design choice, or is a concrete tool/repo/paper the colony should harvest next. General AI hype, product launches without transferable technique, and off-topic threads are not relevance. Prefer items you can map to a named package/dir.

Reply format:
RELEVANT (<n> of <new>):
For each relevant story, one block:
- <TITLE> — <url or hnLink>
  <1-2 sentences: what it offers, and WHICH agentruntime subsystem it touches (name the package/dir). Confidence: high|medium|low (title-only evidence).>
Order by relevance, strongest first.
End with: SKIPPED: <count> — <one clause on the dominant reason>.

meta.description: Judge — fresh Grok 4.5 + ar-tools, reads the repo for grounding, shortlists with subsystem mapping. Read-only by instruction. Title/metadata only.
Fire-and-forget digest back to the operator's conversation.
